C0969.title: Legality of Automated AFK Scripts: Legal Consultation
C0969.summary: A lawyer on Hualv.com explains that automated AFK scripts may be illegal if used to maliciously farm game resources, disrupt game balance, interfere with other players' normal gaming experience, or violate the game's terms of service.
